Return a concise report with file paths and whether the scrutiny blocking issue (no runtime evidence for resources) is true ON THE WORKTREE or only true if you look at origin/main.

Do not modify files.
---END TASK FROM PARENT AGENT---
I'll compare resource tests in the mission worktree versus the original checkout and check recent commits.

content.text:
## Resource tests: worktree vs main

**Both checkouts have** `/packages/core/src/resources/hevy.test.ts` (plus `hevy.ts`).

### Worktree `/root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer` (`feat/effect-ops-layer`)
File: `/root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer/packages/core/src/resources/hevy.test.ts`

| Assertion | Present? |
|---|---|
| `hevy://user` → `user.get` | Yes. `"dispatches every resource through the operations layer"` stubs `user.get.effect` and expects `userGet` once. |
| `hevy://workout-count` → `workouts.count` | Yes. Same test stubs `workouts.count.effect`. |
| `hevy://exercise-templates` uses catalog / `templates.listAll` | Yes. Same test stubs `templates.listAll`; catalog-sharing test also mocks `listAll.effect`. |
| `hevy://routine-folders` → `folders.listAll` | Yes. Same test stubs `folders.listAll.effect`. |
| Four URIs unchanged | Yes. `"registers all four static JSON resources"`: `hevy://user`, `hevy://workout-count`, `hevy://exercise-templates`, `hevy://routine-folders`. |
| No Promise HevyClient resource methods called | **Partial.** The dispatch test asserts `getUserInfo` / `getWorkoutCount` / `getExerciseTemplates` / `getRoutineFolders` were **not** called. Other tests still mock those Promise client methods (folder pagination, empty page, API failure). |

**Pass:** `8 passed` (`cd /root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer && mise exec -- pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/resources/hevy.test.ts`).

HEAD: `93af7ba test(core): cover operation-backed resource reads`.

### Original `/root/hevy-mcp` (`main`)
File: `/root/hevy-mcp/packages/core/src/resources/hevy.test.ts`

Same four URIs. **Does not** assert operations (`user.get`, `workouts.count`, `templates.listAll`, `folders.listAll`). Catalog test hits `hevyClient.getExerciseTemplates`. **7 tests**, no dispatch-through-operations case.

**Pass:** 7/7 when run from `/root/hevy-mcp`.

## Commits (`origin/main..HEAD`)

```
93af7ba test(core): cover operation-backed resource reads
5de8df5 refactor: route core tools through operations
c69f455 refactor: collapse core effects at boundaries
1459bf0 feat(core): share exercise template effect cache
...
```

Exact strings `core-resources-via-operations` / `core-tool-runtime-collapse` are **not** in commit messages. Closest latest commits:

- `93af7ba` — resource-via-operations coverage
- `5de8df5` — core tools through operations
- `c69f455` — collapse core effects at boundaries

Branch: `feat/effect-ops-layer...origin/main [ahead 15]`.

## File counts (worktree)

- `packages/core/src/resources/`: 2 (`hevy.ts`, `hevy.test.ts`)
- `packages/core/src/tools/*.test.ts`: **15** worktree vs **16** on main (main still has `mutation-semantics.test.ts`)

## Scrutiny blocking issue

**False on the worktree.** Runtime evidence exists: `93af7ba` + the dispatch test + 8 passing tests.

**True only if you look at `origin/main` / `/root/hevy-mcp`:** resources tests never assert the operations layer.
